title: Chris Tucker and Bernie Mac: Unfiltered on Def Comedy Jam
description:
Before Rush Hour. Before Friday. Before Chris Tucker became one of the highest-paid actors in Hollywood — he was right here on Def Comedy Jam, 20 years old, absolutely on fire. Tucker tears through neighbors who borrow your stuff and never return it, a Black president who won't cut the White House lawn, getting caught by his mama, and why Michael Jackson would have made the world's most entertaining pimp. 

Alonzo Jones brings the church — five collections, a Mac machine in the lobby, and a pastor with some very suspicious-looking babies. Bernie Mac is back and he's not scared of anybody — raw, unfiltered, and better than ever. Kevin Anthony rounds out the night. Martin Lawrence hosts. Kid Capri on the decks. This is Russell Simmons' Def Comedy Jam at its finest — Season 2, Episode 1.
